entries.text: DataFusion now refuses a DELETE or UPDATE whose WHERE clause plans as a join or subquery, because DataFusion 55 removes every row for such statements without an error (apache/datafusion#24657). Plain literal-key deletes and simple predicates still run.

TPC-DS data maintenance now counts the rows each DELETE predicate matches and fails the function when the rows removed differ, and TPC-H RF2 now compares the lineitem and orders rows it removes against the rows matching the delete keys. The counting runs outside the measured interval on every platform.
